_comment: Cross-lane ADVISORY prerequisites (G6 R10). Authored, never derived from `unlocks` — `unlocks` is within-lane ordering, this is what one lane leans on in another. Nothing here blocks entry: an edge renders a chip that names the skill, says where the learner is in it, and taps straight there. A lesson with no edge shows no chip. `why` is learner-facing copy and completes the clause "leans on <strand> — <why>".
